title: Dental Bridge vs Implant: How to Choose (2026 Guide)
seoTitle: Dental Bridge vs Implant: How to Choose
seoDescription: Bridge or implant for a missing tooth? Compare lifespan, bone health, adjacent teeth, cost and insurance, then plan your choice in Valencia.
excerpt: A bridge is faster and often covered by insurance; an implant spares neighboring teeth and protects bone. See which fits your mouth, budget and timeline.
keyTakeaways: A bridge replaces only the crown and leans on neighboring teeth; an implant replaces the root and the crown.
Bridges often last 7 to 15 years; implants commonly last 10 to 30 years with good maintenance.
A bridge requires reshaping adjacent teeth; an implant leaves healthy neighbors untouched.
Insurance often covers a bridge but not implant surgery or grafting, which tilts many decisions.
If adjacent teeth already need crowns, a bridge can be efficient; if they are sound, an implant often wins.
